s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological and systemic symptoms with signs of infection and inflammation
salient_findings: Progressive headache, phonophobia, high-grade fever, vomiting, and watery diarrhea
Nuchal rigidity without focal neurologic deficits
key_facts: 44-year-old woman with a history of systemic lupus erythematosus
Recent treatment for SLE-associated thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
Presented with a one-week history of progressive headache and fever
Had hemoglobin of 11.2 g/dL, eosinophils 150 cells/mm3, and creatinine 0.8 mg/dL
Lumbar puncture revealed low glucose, high protein, and 42 white cells/mm3
Cerebrospinal fluid culture grew Enterococcus gallinarum
Developed hemoptysis, bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates, and acute respiratory failure
Required mechanical ventilation and ICU admission
Developed a purpuric skin rash on hospital day 4

shortlist.label: Enterococcal meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Cerebrospinal fluid culture grew Enterococcus gallinarum

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus flare
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of SLE and presented with systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Bacterial meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had signs of meningitis, including nuchal rigidity and cerebrospinal fluid abnormalities

shortlist.label: Infective endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed hemoptysis and bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates, which could be related to endocarditis

shortlist.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had a recent history of TTP and presented with systemic symptoms and hemoptysis

raw.rationale: Cerebrospinal fluid culture grew Enterococcus gallinarum, which explains the patient's symptoms of headache, fever, and nuchal rigidity

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus flare
rejected.why: Lack of clinical signs of lupus activity and normal C3 levels suggest that SLE is not the primary cause of the current symptoms

rejected.label: Bacterial meningitis
rejected.why: While the patient has meningitis, the specific cause is identified as Enterococcus gallinarum

rejected.label: Infective endocarditis
rejected.why: No evidence of endocarditis is presented in the case

rejected.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
rejected.why: The patient was recently treated for TTP, but the current symptoms are more consistent with an infectious process
